criteria: Blank scaffold compiles before generation and contains no Select/Dialog solution.
Only the two consumer skills are installed through the public GitHub subpath; installed bytes match a recorded revision.
Generated AppSelect is standalone and compiles against its value/valueChange, disabled and label API in an independent host.
The generated app and independent host pass unchanged strict TypeScript/Angular template configuration and use public installed package imports without workspace inputs.
Selecting Public updates the actual parent value exactly once; external Private/Public updates render without a spurious valueChange.
Disabled prevents opening and changing; re-enabling restores operation.
Dialog and combobox expose the requested accessible names.
Value survives closing and reopening the generated Dialog.
Real keyboard selection works; first Escape closes Select, second closes Dialog.
Focus returns to the Select trigger and then the Dialog trigger after overlay removal; modality contains Tab and Shift+Tab.
Consumer CSS uses application tokens; no visual reference or aesthetic scoring is used.
Browser pageerror/console errors and leftover overlays or page locks fail the check.
rules: Freeze criteria and checks before generation.
Retain agent self-corrections in the same session.
Do not repair generated code from the evaluator.
Separate infrastructure failures from model failures.
